verdict.line: You lose if you let E (Test of Spirit) tick on you with no minions nearby; you win if you out-scale her past level 11.

brief.thesis: This matchup is a 49% coinflip over 145 games because Illaoi's whole kill condition is landing E (Test of Spirit) and W (Harsh Lesson) procs on you while Tentacles swing, but Dr. Mundo's Passive (Adrenaline Rush) and W (Burning Agony) sustain through exactly that kind of poke. Whoever manages Tentacle uptime and wave position decides the lane, not raw damage.

theirWindow.when: E lands and you're away from minions
theirWindow.what: Her spirit link echoes damage back onto you and nearby Tentacles swing at the link, so this is her biggest health swing. Walk back to your wave immediately so the spirit snaps and the echo window closes early.

yourWindow.when: her E and Q (Tentacle Smash) are both down
yourWindow.what: With no spirit link and no fresh Tentacle, she has no way to punish an all-in. Dump Q (Infected Cleaver) and stack E (Masochism) off your missing health for a free trade.

powerCurve.note: both weak, Doran's items decide first trades
E (Test of Spirit) online, Tentacle poke adds up
Burning Agony and sustain items close the gap
Warmog's/Heartsteel health pool dwarfs her burst
R (Sadism) kiting negates her all-in fully

start.why: Flat damage reduction on autos directly answers her poke-heavy W (Harsh Lesson) and Tentacle swings, and the sustain pairs with your Passive (Adrenaline Rush) to win the war of attrition.

boots.why: Measured at 56.6% win over 83 games; the extra movement speed matters for walking back into minion range before her E (Test of Spirit) spirit link snaps.

core.why: Raw HP scales your Q (Infected Cleaver) true damage and out-tanks the Tentacle chip she relies on.
Converts your stacked HP into damage, turning the sustain race into a threat she has to respect.
Boosted heal/shield power stacks with Adrenaline Rush and Burning Agony to out-heal her entire poke pattern.

situational.when: she's building into a heal-reliant or crit-adjacent composition
you're ahead and want to pressure her wave and Tentacles faster
her Tentacle auto-attack poke is outpacing your early sustain

runes.keystoneWhy: Procs off trading autos in melee range, which is exactly where this lane happens, and stacks the HP that both Warmog's and Heartsteel want.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport is run in 47.1% of games at 37.6% pick; Teleport lets you reset off her poke and still return with full wave state, while Flash dodges the E (Test of Spirit) grab at range.

playing.title: Hold minion proximity on cooldown windows
playing.detail: Her E (Test of Spirit) spirit link breaks early if the target is near minions, so never stand isolated when her E is up.

playing.title: Trade only when her Q and E are down
playing.detail: Tentacle Smash and Test of Spirit are her only real damage tools; an all-in without both up is close to free for you.

playing.title: Use Q (Infected Cleaver) for wave control, not just damage
playing.detail: At a 4s cooldown you can clear casters and chip her health simultaneously without ever entering melee range.

playing.title: Pop E (Masochism) only after taking a trade
playing.detail: Its AD bonus scales off missing health, so trigger it right after she lands damage, not before.

playing.title: Don't contest early skirmishes before level 6
playing.detail: Her Tentacle poke plus W (Harsh Lesson) burst edges you out here; play for sustain, not kills.

playing.title: Save R (Sadism) to disengage, not all-in
playing.detail: The movement speed and regen let you kite her Tentacle zone rather than commit to a fight you don't need.

playing.title: Track her Idol timer if she has it
playing.detail: Her R (Leap of Faith) spawns a Tentacle per champion hit; don't group with allies in her 450 range.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and summoner picks are pulled from measured games on the current patch (16.20.1); the matchup reasoning, timings, and trade windows are my own tactical read, not scraped data.

stats.opponentTip: Illaoi’s (E) makes it difficult to manage your health. Avoid (E) by staying behind minions!
